features.name: Active Pool
features.description: The Active Pool is the Water Gardens' dramatic 38-foot-deep architectural basin, reached visually by descending table-topped steps beside rushing water.

features.name: Quiet Pool
features.description: The Quiet Pool is a shaded, recessed reflecting pool framed by tall cypress trees and water walls near the Water Gardens' northwest entrance.
